schema.description: A JSON document owned by the upstream contract; the BFF does not interpret it.
schema.title: Passthrough

404.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504), route-not-allowed (500), internal-error (500) and client-closed-request (499, the caller went away). Any route also answers 404 resource-not-found for a path it does not serve (or one containing NUL) and 405 method-not-allowed for a wrong method.
